text: Wants a citation for every non-obvious claim, linked inline. #citations
Prefers [[primary-sources]] over secondary summaries; quote the original. #methodology
Default summary shape: TL;DR, then key findings, then [[open-questions]]. #format
[[arXiv]] is the go-to for AI/ML preprints; check the latest version, not v1. #sources
Flag [[conflicting-sources]] explicitly instead of silently picking one. #methodology #uncertainty
Distinguish a [[benchmark]] result from a vendor's marketing claim. #methodology
Note the publication date; flag anything older than ~18 months as possibly stale. #freshness
When sources disagree, present both and explain the [[trade-offs]]. #methodology
[[peer-review]] status matters: preprint vs. published vs. blog post is worth stating. #sources
Separate what the [[source]] says from your own inference, label each. #methodology
Adopted the [[summarize]] skill as the default research-to-writeup workflow. #format
For numeric claims, prefer the [[dataset]] or table over a prose restatement. #methodology
